ValidationRule.description: 當Transportation = Chauffeur service arranged by passenger(自行預訂接送機服務) ，【Driver Info】【Driver's Phone】為必填
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL(Transportation__c, "Chauffeur service (arranged by passenger)"), OR( ISBLANK(Driver_Info__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_Phone__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When the Transportation = Chauffeur service (arranged by passenger),【Driver Info】【Driver's Phone】can't be empty.
